title: I RL-trained an agent that trains models with RL (for ~$1.3k)
claim: Show HN: I RL-trained an agent that trains models with RL (for ~$1.3k)
why_good: An agent RL-trained to itself train models with RL, cheaply (~$1.3k) — a striking recursive-automation demo with real cost implications.
value: The opportunity is cheap automated RL-training-as-a-service; the demo hints at a product, but isn't one yet.
risk: Impressive experiment, not a productized business; RL infra is compute-heavy and the labs move fast.

zh.claim: Show HN: 我用 RL 训练了一个 用 RL 训练模型 的 agent(约 $1.3k)。
